method: Offline composition of retained source materials; no image generation, atlas enlargement, or runtime texture enlargement.

source_records.role: Sole geographic authority; already densified road points, widths, parcels, shores and prop positions.
Retained raw-sheet crop registrations, not exported 24px tiles.
Bounded transparent trees, understory, rocks and river plants.
Canonical farm and relief props only; no invented settlement or gate.
Grass tufts, rubble and broken rails; animated animals are not baked.
High-detail raw material cells, sampled after reduction, never enlarged.
Raw subdued pasture and earth material; not the tiny runtime exports.
One uniform reduction supplies unchanged broken faces and additional retained outer masonry/cobble columns for the new assembled bridge only; approved runtime bridge images remain read-only.
Measured 72px clear deck registration and original bridge component crops.
Water-only bounded material sample; none of its river, bridge, bank, horizon or buildings is copied.

material_sampling: Raw bounded crop, uniform nearest reduction (<=1), three-candidate minimum-error overlap quilting. Only water has the explicitly recorded per-channel mean-centered contrast reduction and RGB multiply before quilting. Source crop positions/flips are recorded in material_samples.json; no repeating 24px tile is loaded.

bridge.assembly_method: New assembled art, not a simple crop export: copy retained outer masonry/parapet/arch-front columns 1:1 after the sole uniform source reduction, with split/staggered added cobble courses. Original inner jagged faces and approved runtime bridge images are unchanged.
bridge.framing_limitation: 480px viewport shows the central collapse, both broken abutment faces and inner portions of both damage parcels; the eastern terminal approach is partly cropped. Use the unscaled 960x480 bridge reference to inspect the whole 504px physical deck and both complete scorch parcels.
bridge.note: Only this newly authored bridge is assembled art, not a simple crop export of the approved runtime bridge. One uniform 232/1774 stone scale supplies both unchanged inner jagged faces and 84px of additional retained OUTER masonry/parapet/arch-front columns per bank. Two outer panel strips and three split/staggered cobble courses form each 200px abutment without repainting or stretching the source. The actual transparent collapse is measured from output alpha. The full physical 18-tile deck stays 504x72px under the unchanged projection; river, camera and actor registration are unchanged.

checks: Inputs are pinned by original SHA256. PNG --check accepts identical decoded RGBA when PNG compression differs; JSON must match exactly. Normal local builds use deterministic compression and retain already-identical files.
